fuss.hinweis: This page guesses. It assumes every station is tuned to 440 Hz and pulls everything down by a flat 1.8 percent. On a live recording, a historical performance or a track produced at 432 in the first place, it therefore detunes in the wrong direction. IYAMBAE Tuner measures the actual tuning and corrects it exactly — and handles tunings other than 432 Hz as well. If the app is running on this machine, the page notices by itself and leaves the field to it.

stimmung.erklaerung: What makes this place different: every station can play at 432 Hz instead of the usual 440.
stimmung.abstand: This page guesses: it assumes every station sits at 440 Hz and pulls everything down by the same amount. If a recording sits at 443 — common today — what you are hearing right now is 435 Hz, not 432.
stimmung.loesung: The IYAMBAE Tuner measures the actual tuning and lands on 432.33 Hz — across your whole computer, not just here. Free, no account.
